prompts.prompt: deposit 100 usdc, 100 usdt and 1 sol in lending pool
prompts.why: a list of amounts is three Earn supply steps

prompts.prompt: can you deposit 100 USDC in margin account and borrow SOL 3x against that USDC
forbid: How much SOL do you want to borrow
prompts.why: a leverage target on a borrow is sized by the server

prompts.prompt: put 100 USDC plus 100 USDT plus 1 SOL into the pool
prompts.why: an unfamiliar verb is understood as supplying, not read as pool rates

prompts.prompt: how much more could I borrow in USDC without getting close to liquidation?
prompts.why: investigates capacity at the floor and answers with tool figures

prompts.prompt: which pool pays me the most right now if I just want to earn on stables?
prompts.why: reads pool rates and compares USDC vs USDT

prompts.prompt: I want 2x long SOL exposure, use USDC as the loan
prompts.why: a leveraged long goes to the lever planner

prompts.prompt: borrow the max usdc that is safe and swap it to SOL inside my margin account
prompts.why: max_safe borrow then previous_leg swap; a wallet with no margin account is told there is no capacity

prompts.prompt: what's the weather like in Delhi
prompts.why: off-topic is declined by the model

prompts.prompt: is my account safe if SOL drops 20%?
prompts.why: liquidation distance from tools, no price prediction

prompts.prompt: move half my wallet USDC into earn
prompts.why: fraction sizing from the wallet balance

prompts.prompt: take a loan of usdc using 0.5 sol in margin accout with 2x leveraage, use my existing collateral sol
prompts.why: a loan at 2x on named collateral: one borrow sized on 0.5 SOL, nothing swapped

prompts.prompt: take a loan of sol using 10 jitosol as collateral in margin account and use leverage of 5x
prompts.why: deposit 10 JitoSOL (not yet in the margin account) + leverage borrow, nothing swapped
a leveraged long: borrow a stable and swap into SOL

prompts.prompt: supply 20 USDC to earn, deposit 1 SOL as collateral and borrow 10 USDT
prompts.why: three transactions, in order, nothing added

prompts.prompt: borrow 20 USDC and swap it to SOL in my margin account
prompts.why: the user asked for the swap, so it is there

prompts.prompt: deposit 0.5 SOL as collateral and take a 3x leverage loan in USDC
prompts.why: deposit + leverage borrow on the deposit, nothing swapped
